types.ForestState.initial_state_agreement_iff:
∀ (t s : RMAF.Tree) (F : List (List Nat)),
  ForestState.proper (some t) [s] = true → (ForestState.agrees (some t) [s] F = true ↔ RMAF.agreement t s F = true)
types.ForestState.singleton_cleanup_forward:
∀ (T : Option RMAF.Tree) (ss : List RMAF.Tree) (F : List (List Nat)) (a : Nat),
  ForestState.agrees T ss F = true →
    RMAF.Tree.leaf a ∈ ss →
      ForestState.agrees (ForestState.cleanupTarget T a) (ForestState.cleanupSources ss a)
          (ForestState.cleanupForest F a) =
        true
types.ForestState.singleton_cleanup_reverse:
∀ (T : Option RMAF.Tree) (ss : List RMAF.Tree) (G : List (List Nat)) (a : Nat),
  ForestState.proper T ss = true →
    RMAF.Tree.leaf a ∈ ss →
      ForestState.agrees (ForestState.cleanupTarget T a) (ForestState.cleanupSources ss a) G = true →
        ForestState.agrees T ss ([a] :: G) = true
types.ForestState.singleton_additional_cost:
∀ (T : Option RMAF.Tree) (ss : List RMAF.Tree) (F : List (List Nat)) (a : Nat),
  ForestState.agrees T ss F = true →
    RMAF.Tree.leaf a ∈ ss →
      ForestState.additionalCost (ForestState.cleanupSources ss a) (ForestState.cleanupForest F a) =
        ForestState.additionalCost ss F
types.ForestState.singleton_reconstruction_cos:
∀ (ss : List RMAF.Tree) (G : List (List Nat)) (a : Nat),
  RMAF.Tree.leaf a ∈ ss →
    ForestState.additionalCost ss ([a] :: G) = ForestState.additionalCost (ForestState.cleanupSources ss a) G
types.ForestState.singleton_decision_equivalen:
∀ (T : Option RMAF.Tree) (ss : List RMAF.Tree) (a q : Nat),
  ForestState.proper T ss = true →
    RMAF.Tree.leaf a ∈ ss →
      (ForestState.feasible T ss q ↔
        ForestState.feasible (ForestState.cleanupTarget T a) (ForestState.cleanupSources ss a) q)
types.ForestState.singleton_strict_decrease:
∀ (T : Option RMAF.Tree) (ss : List RMAF.Tree) (F : List (List Nat)) (a : Nat),
  ForestState.agrees T ss F = true →
    RMAF.Tree.leaf a ∈ ss →
      (ForestState.labels (ForestState.cleanupTarget T a)).length + 1 = (ForestState.labels T).length
types.ForestState.cleanup_proper:
∀ (T : Option RMAF.Tree) (ss : List RMAF.Tree) (a : Nat),
  ForestState.proper T ss = true →
    RMAF.Tree.leaf a ∈ ss → ForestState.proper (ForestState.cleanupTarget T a) (ForestState.cleanupSources ss a) = true
types.ForestState.cleanup_labels:
∀ (T : Option RMAF.Tree) (a : Nat),
  (ForestState.labels T).Nodup → ForestState.labels (ForestState.cleanupTarget T a) = (ForestState.labels T).erase a
types.ForestState.singleton_source_owner:
∀ (T : Option RMAF.Tree) (ss : List RMAF.Tree) (a : Nat),
  ForestState.proper T ss = true →
    RMAF.Tree.leaf a ∈ ss →
      a ∈ ForestState.labels T ∧ ∀ (s : RMAF.Tree), s ∈ ss → a ∈ RMAF.leaves s → s = RMAF.Tree.leaf a
types.ForestState.endpoint_reassignment_embedd:
∀ (t : RMAF.Tree) (A C : List Nat) (a b : Nat),
  (RMAF.leaves t).Nodup →
    ForestState.cherry a b t = true →
      a ∈ A →
        ¬b ∈ A →
          ¬a ∈ C →
            ¬b ∈ C →
              RMAF.disjointVertices (RMAF.minimalVertices A t) (RMAF.minimalVertices C t) = true →
                RMAF.disjointVertices (RMAF.minimalVertices (b :: A) t) (RMAF.minimalVertices C t) = true
types.ForestState.common_cherry_no_larger:
∀ (t : RMAF.Tree) (ss : List RMAF.Tree) (F : List (List Nat)) (a b : Nat),
  ForestState.agrees (some t) ss F = true →
    ForestState.cherry a b t = true →
      (∃ s, s ∈ ss ∧ ForestState.cherry a b s = true) →
        ∃ G, ForestState.agrees (some t) ss G = true ∧ G.length ≤ F.length ∧ ∃ B, B ∈ G ∧ a ∈ B ∧ b ∈ B
types.ForestState.common_cherry_contract_agree:
∀ (t : RMAF.Tree) (ss : List RMAF.Tree) (F : List (List Nat)) (a b z : Nat),
  ForestState.agrees (some t) ss F = true →
    ForestState.cherryReady (some t) ss a b z = true →
      ForestState.Coalesced F a b →
        ForestState.agrees (some (ForestState.contract a b z t)) (List.map (ForestState.contract a b z) ss)
            (List.map (ForestState.contractBlock a b z) F) =
          true
types.ForestState.common_cherry_expand_agreeme:
∀ (t : RMAF.Tree) (ss : List RMAF.Tree) (G : List (List Nat)) (a b z : Nat),
  ForestState.cherryReady (some t) ss a b z = true →
    ForestState.agrees (some (ForestState.contract a b z t)) (List.map (ForestState.contract a b z) ss) G = true →
      ForestState.agrees (some t) ss (List.map (ForestState.expandBlock a b z) G) = true
types.ForestState.contraction_additional_cost:
∀ (ss : List RMAF.Tree) (F : List (List Nat)) (a b z : Nat),
  ForestState.additionalCost (List.map (ForestState.contract a b z) ss) (List.map (ForestState.contractBlock a b z) F) =
    ForestState.additionalCost ss F
types.ForestState.common_cherry_expand_exact_c:
∀ (ss : List RMAF.Tree) (G : List (List Nat)) (a b z : Nat),
  ForestState.additionalCost ss (List.map (ForestState.expandBlock a b z) G) =
    ForestState.additionalCost (List.map (ForestState.contract a b z) ss) G
types.ForestState.common_cherry_decision_forwa:
∀ (t : RMAF.Tree) (ss : List RMAF.Tree) (a b z q : Nat),
  ForestState.cherryReady (some t) ss a b z = true →
    ForestState.feasible (some t) ss q →
      ForestState.feasible (some (ForestState.contract a b z t)) (List.map (ForestState.contract a b z) ss) q
types.ForestState.common_cherry_decision_rever:
∀ (t : RMAF.Tree) (ss : List RMAF.Tree) (a b z q : Nat),
  ForestState.cherryReady (some t) ss a b z = true →
    ForestState.feasible (some (ForestState.contract a b z t)) (List.map (ForestState.contract a b z) ss) q →
      ForestState.feasible (some t) ss q
types.ForestState.common_cherry_decision_equiv:
∀ (t : RMAF.Tree) (ss : List RMAF.Tree) (a b z q : Nat),
  ForestState.cherryReady (some t) ss a b z = true →
    (ForestState.feasible (some t) ss q ↔
      ForestState.feasible (some (ForestState.contract a b z t)) (List.map (ForestState.contract a b z) ss) q)
types.ForestState.common_cherry_state_decision:
∀ (T : Option RMAF.Tree) (ss : List RMAF.Tree) (a b z q : Nat),
  ForestState.cherryReady T ss a b z = true →
    (ForestState.feasible T ss q ↔
      ForestState.feasible (Option.map (ForestState.contract a b z) T) (List.map (ForestState.contract a b z) ss) q)
types.ForestState.common_cherry_state_strict_d:
∀ (T : Option RMAF.Tree) (ss : List RMAF.Tree) (a b z : Nat),
  ForestState.cherryReady T ss a b z = true →
    (ForestState.labels (Option.map (ForestState.contract a b z) T)).length + 1 = (ForestState.labels T).length
